checks: idle.passed is True; idle.revision == revision; idle.identity == facts; idle.qualification_attempt == qualification_attempt; idle.idle_attempt == selected idle_attempt
idle.all_owned_trees_reaped is True; idle.cleanup_errors == []; idle.source_and_package_unchanged is True; idle.helper_unchanged is True

idle.owning_profile.original_config_hash == owning_profile.config_hash; idle.owning_profile.same_original_receipt_ref == receipt_ref; idle.owning_profile.same_original_data_root is True; idle.workflow_authorized is False; idle.owning_profile.workflow_authorized is False

idle.selection_generation is exact positive int; compare against actual selection.generation; selected envelope product_config_hash equals idle.owning_profile.idle_config_hash; selected owner workflow_authorized is False; source_subject.qualification_receipt_ref == receipt_ref
checkpoint_binding.existing_variable_order: receipt_ref is currently assigned after output creation. Derive q[result][receipt_ref] earlier for prerequisite validation or perform binding immediately after that assignment but before original-software-before command.
checkpoint_binding.direct_store_identity_gap: Current idle owning_profile has original_config_hash/idle_config_hash, same_original_data_root boolean and same_original_receipt_ref only. It does not independently name original config/data/canonical/instance. For literal same-store comparison add only external-helper report fields from existing original_path/data/original.database_path/original.product_instance_id, using same PROJECT-relative refs as backup owning_profile.
checkpoint_binding.backup_compare: Compare those four directly with owning_profile config_ref/data_root_ref/canonical_ref/product_instance_id. Do not replace original diagnostic config_hash with idle config_hash; they intentionally differ.

typed_selection.helper: def selection(path, immutable=False): with open_paper_selections(path, immutable=immutable) as reader: return reader.current()
typed_selection.signature: open_paper_selections(path, *, immutable=False) returns context-manager readonly reader; current() -> OperationalSelection | None; reads validate namespace/schema/contiguous generations/hash/canonical record, never allocate generation
typed_selection.equality: OperationalSelection is frozen dataclass(generation, config_hash, canonical_json); direct == compares all three. as_dict() only for selected false workflow/source receipt/envelope config assertions; retain canonical equality rather than comparing selected subset.

paths.RESTORED: restored_config.database_path, immutable=False after restore result and fence validation
paths.CAPTURED: captured(backup), immutable=True after verify-owning-backup returns verified

insertion_points: Immediately after original=receipt(config.database_path), assign original_selection=selection(config.database_path), require non-None and bind generation/idle config/receipt/workflow to idle checkpoint.
Beside repeated/verified_again and rebackup receipt comparison require selection(captured(rebackup),True)==original_selection.

Final original-software-after/history/config unchanged guard also require selection(config.database_path)==original_selection. Record explicit actual_current_protected_selection_equal_across_four_stores only after all checks succeed.
typed_selection.privacy: Evidence needs only generation/config_hash/canonical-json hash, workflow=false and receipt ref; do not emit complete owner/policy/account bodies.

whole_file_scope.fact: Existing four-way require_same_captured_file compares product manifest files only. Canonical databases live separately under bundle/databases and are not those files. Database snapshots are separately verified and restored databases intentionally receive restore/auth/process fences; equal whole SQLite bytes across all four stores are neither currently asserted nor appropriate.
whole_file_scope.consequence: Full captured DB verification covers integrity of its protected rows but does not substitute for explicit source/captured/restored/rebackup selection semantic equality. The proposed typed comparison supplies exact row identity without changing restoration fences.

limitations: External helper changes only; no production contract/framework changes necessary.
Read-only mapping only; no checkpoint/runtime/DB/auth reads, no tests/native/network execution, no acceptance claim.
